content.title: What time does ‘Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special’ premiere on Disney+?
content.text: Updated: Mar. 23, 2026, 6:00 p.m.Published: Mar. 23, 2026, 6:00 p.m.The "Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special" streams Tuesday, March 24, on Disney+ and Hulu.Disney+If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Madison Kemeny | MKemeny@syracuse.comDisney is celebrating two decades of Disney Channel’s “Hannah Montana” with a brand-new anniversary special, premiering on Disney+ and Hulu. The unscripted “Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special“ will feature a live studio audience and a sit-down conversation with series star Miley Cyrus, revisiting the show that launched her career and became a defining franchise for a generation of viewers.When does the ‘Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special’ premiere?The special begins streaming Tuesday, March 24, and will be available on Disney+ and Hulu starting around 12 a.m. PT / 3 a.m. ET. It will stream exclusively on the platform, with no television airing announced.How to watch the ‘Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special’Although Disney+ and Hulu don’t offer free trials, viewers can bundle their subscriptions to reduce the monthly cost. The Disney+ and Hulu bundle combines Disney+ with Hulu for $12.99/month, saving 45% compared to subscribing separately. The Disney Unlimited bundle combines Disney+, Hulu and ESPN+ together, offering additional live sports and entertainment programming for $35.99/month, saving 33%.Disney+Starting at $11.99/moStream the "Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special," along with all four seasons of “Hannah Montana” on Disney+.Stream NowSubscribers can also revisit the full series ahead of the special. All four seasons of “Hannah Montana” are currently available on Disney+, along with the feature film" Hannah Montana: The Movie" and the concert film “Hannah Montana & Miley Cyrus: Best of Both Worlds Concert.”What to expect from the ‘Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special’Rather than a scripted reboot, the anniversary special is structured as a retrospective “love letter to fans.” It’ll feature Miley Cyrus sitting down for an in-depth conversation hosted by “Call Her Daddy’s” Alex Cooper.
